summary.abstract_hr: Emisija medija Ora et Labora počinje nizom molitava: molitvom za zaštitu od zlih sila, posvetom Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu i Presvetom Srcu Isusovu, Krunicom Božjega milosrđa, Litanijama Božjem milosrđu, žalosnim otajstvima Gospine krunice i molitvom Zdravo kraljice. Potom slijedi tumačenje Poslanice Filipljanima, Psalma i evanđelja (Lk 14,1-6) o Isusovu subotnjem ozdravljenju čovjeka s vodenom bolešću u kući farizejskog prvaka. Voditelj naglašava da je 'dan Kristov' dan suda, da Isus nije samo milosrdni spasitelj nego i sudac te da bez suda nema milosrđa. Poziva vjernike da svakodnevno pitaju Boga za njegovu volju i da se čuvaju farizejskog duha, osobito izrugivanja Božjim djelima, koje opisuje kao grijeh protiv Duha Svetoga. Na kraju najavljuje promocije knjige 'Isus Lider' i predstavljanja domoljubne inicijative Ora et Labora u više gradova te poziva na javnu molitvu krunice.
key_points: Voditelj ističe da sveti Pavao u Poslanici Filipljanima gotovo u svakoj rečenici spominje Isusa Krista jer mu je srce puno ljubavi prema Kristu, a što je u srcu, to izlazi na usta.
'Dan Kristov' tumači kao osobni susret s Isusom pri smrti (prvi sud) i kao dan kada Isus sudi svim narodima. Naglašava da je Isus i sudac i milosrdni Bog jer bez suda nema milosrđa.

Prema tumačenju Psalma, 'zbor pravednika' čine oni koji vrše volju Božju, a ne samo oni koji podižu ruke i pjevaju Bogu. Zato vjernici trebaju svaki dan pitati Boga što trebaju činiti, što voditelj slikovito uspoređuje s djetetom koje ne pita oca za njegovu volju.

Isus je otišao na objed kod farizeja iako je znao da mu spremaju klopku jer mu je bilo stalo do njihova obraćenja. Ozdravljenjem bolesnika pred njihovim očima onemogućio im je da kažu kako nisu znali za Božje djelo.

Nazivati Božje djelo ozdravljenja i oslobađanja đavoljim djelom voditelj opisuje kao grijeh protiv Duha Svetoga. Kritizira one koji se na društvenim mrežama izruguju karizmaticima i kaže da osobno ne komentira tuđi rad.
Vjernike poziva da se čuvaju 'kvasca farizejskoga', da svjedoče, budu čvrsti u vjeri i ustraju do kraja jer će se, prema Svetom pismu, oni koji ustraju spasiti.

Najavljuje molitvu krunice, promociju knjige 'Isus Lider' (treći dio) i predstavljanje domoljubne inicijative Ora et Labora u Ljubuškom (30. listopada), Prozoru-Rami (31. listopada), Biogradu na Moru (2. studenog), Solinu (3. studenog) i Imotskom (4. studenog). Također poziva na javnu molitvu krunice 7. studenog.
key_topics_en: prayer and the chaplet of divine mercy
announcement of events and book promotion
key_points_en: The host points out that Saint Paul mentions Jesus Christ in almost every sentence in the Epistle to the Philippians because his heart is full of love for Christ, and what is in the heart comes out through the mouth.

He interprets the 'Day of Christ' as a personal encounter with Jesus at death (the particular judgment) and as the day when Jesus judges all nations. He emphasizes that Jesus is both a judge and a merciful God because without judgment there is no mercy.

According to the interpretation of the Psalm, the 'assembly of the righteous' consists of those who do the will of God, not only those who raise their hands and sing to God. Therefore, the faithful should ask God every day what they ought to do, which the host vividly compares to a child who does not ask the father for his will.

Jesus went to a meal at the Pharisees' house even though He knew they were setting a trap for Him because He cared about their conversion. By healing the sick man before their eyes, He made it impossible for them to say that they did not know about God's work.

Calling God's work of healing and deliverance the work of the devil is described by the host as a sin against the Holy Spirit. He criticizes those who mock charismatics on social networks and says that he personally does not comment on other people's work.

He calls on the faithful to beware of the 'leaven of the Pharisees', to witness, to be firm in faith, and to persevere to the end because, according to Sacred Scripture, those who persevere will be saved.

He announces the prayer of the Rosary, the promotion of the book 'Isus Lider' (part three), and the presentation of the patriotic initiative Ora et Labora in Ljubuški (October 30), Prozor-Rama (October 31), Biograd na Moru (November 2), Solin (November 3), and Imotski (November 4). He also invites to public prayer of the Rosary on November 7.
summary.title_en: 123. Divine Mercy - Day of the Great Judgment!
summary.abstract_en: The show of the Ora et Labora media begins with a series of prayers: a prayer for protection against evil forces, a consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary and the Most Sacred Heart of Jesus, the Chaplet of Divine Mercy, the Litany of Divine Mercy, the sorrowful mysteries of Our Lady's Rosary, and the Hail Holy Queen prayer. This is followed by an interpretation of the Epistle to the Philippians, a Psalm, and the Gospel (Lk 14:1-6) about Jesus's Sabbath healing of a man with dropsy in the house of a ruler of the Pharisees. The host emphasizes that the 'day of Christ' is a day of judgment, that Jesus is not only a merciful savior but also a judge, and that without judgment there is no mercy. He calls upon the faithful to ask God daily for His will and to beware of the Pharisaic spirit, especially mocking God's works, which he describes as a sin against the Holy Spirit. At the end, he announces book promotions for 'Isus Lider' and presentations of the patriotic initiative Ora et Labora in several cities, and invites to public prayer of the Rosary.
